justification: Core Sim-2019 KL/expressibility computation (C1) was independently reproduced against published reference values, and the random-PQC generator produced a wide KL range consistent with a diverse dataset (C2). The proposed GNN approach was qualitatively supported via strong correlations on held-out and Sim19 sets (C3), but key quantitative RMSE claims (C4-C5) were not matched in the downsized rerun. Noisy-backend, extrapolation-to-n=10, and hardware-table claims (C6, C8, C9) were not tested.
one_line: C1-C3 supported (KL matches Sim19; GNN correlates well), but RMSE claims C4-C5 not reproduced; 5/9 tested.
note_on_coverage_count: Judge counted 5/9 tested; our own report attempts to count 6/9 (including C7 as implicitly tested). Both are defensible; we defer to the judge for the WAVE_RESULT one-line.
